Content following a table whose last row is never closed is still converted

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><th>Before</th></tr><tr></table><p>Visible footer</p>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
